title: Talk it through 3.1
role: Shop assistant and customer-service agent handling returns and refunds
can_do: I can ask for or offer a refund, an exchange or store credit.
I can explain a problem with a purchase or a bill.

nodes.partner_line: Hello. I bought this bag yesterday, but the zip is broken.
nodes.translation: Hola. Compré esta bolsa ayer, pero el cierre está roto.

options.text: I'm very sorry. Do you have the receipt?
I'm sorry about that. Let me have a look.
I understand. We can solve this for you.

nodes.partner_line: Yes, here it is. Can I have my money back?
nodes.translation: Sí, aquí está. ¿Puedo recuperar mi dinero?
nodes.model_reply: Yes, we can give you a refund or an exchange.

nodes.partner_line: I'd prefer an exchange. Is it possible to get the same bag in blue?
nodes.translation: Prefiero un cambio. ¿Es posible tener la misma bolsa en azul?

options.text: Yes, we have it in blue in stock.
I'm afraid the blue one is sold out, but I can order it.

nodes.partner_line: At the restaurant: excuse me, I think the bill is wrong.
nodes.translation: En el restaurante: disculpe, creo que la cuenta está mal.

options.text: I'm sorry. Let me check it with you.
Of course. What seems to be the problem?
Thank you for telling me. I'll bring a new bill.

nodes.partner_line: We were charged for two desserts, but we only had one.
nodes.translation: Nos cobraron dos postres, pero solo comimos uno.

options.text: You're right. I'm sorry for the mistake.
I see. I'll take it off the bill right away.
I apologize. The error is mine.

nodes.partner_line: At the bank: my card doesn't work. What can I do?
nodes.translation: En el banco: mi tarjeta no funciona. ¿Qué puedo hacer?

options.text: We can issue a new card today.
Please show me your passport and I'll check your account.
I'll call the card service for you.
